items.q: Is this a running delivery service already?
items.a: No, we're preparing a pilot launch in Georgia and are currently collecting requests to gauge interest and demand.

items.q: Which cities will this be available in?
items.a: We plan to start with a few cities in Georgia. Leave a request from any city — we'll discuss availability with you personally.
We'll discuss the cost after the quiz.
No payment is required during the pilot. We'll discuss payment terms once delivery is ready to launch.

items.q: Is this suitable for both dogs and cats?
items.a: Yes, we have separate concepts for dogs and for cats — you pick the species in the quiz.

items.q: How do I leave a request?
items.a: Take the short quiz on the site and leave your phone number — we'll reach out on WhatsApp, Telegram, or by phone.

items.q: What if my pet has special dietary needs?
items.a: Tell us in the quiz — we'll pass it on to the operator and check the diet with a specialist if needed.
